Tts._comment: Cloud text-to-speech. Set Provider to Google | Azure | Knowlez and supply credentials to enable native-quality Swahili audio. None = built-in browser/device voice. Prefer secrets via env vars (Tts__Knowlez__ApiKey) or user-secrets, not this file.

Speech._comment: Self-hosted Whisper speech-to-text for the pronunciation drill. Start whisper-service, then set Enabled=true (prefer user-secrets: dotnet user-secrets set Speech:Enabled true). Disabled by default so the app runs without it. ApiKey is the shared secret sent as X-Api-Key when the sidecar runs with WHISPER_API_KEY (any non-localhost deployment); supply it via env var Speech__ApiKey or user-secrets, not this file.

Reminders._comment: The daily push reminder. Sent through Expo's push service to phones that have registered a token; nothing is sent to web-only accounts.

Admin._comment: The backoffice (/admin). Emails is a comma-separated list of EXISTING accounts to promote to admin at startup — how the first admin is made; after that, admins grant the role to each other in the backoffice. Register the account before listing it here: sign-up does not verify addresses. Set it outside this file: env var Admin__Emails.

Habit._comment: GET /api/habit/report returns the habit-test metrics to callers presenting this key in X-Report-Key. Empty = the endpoint does not exist (404). Set it outside this file: env var Habit__ReportKey, or dotnet user-secrets.
